Act 5 of 1996
Published on 1 January 1996

[This is the version of this document from 1 January 1996.]

BE it enacted by Parliament in the Forty- seventh Year of the
Republic of India as follows:-
An Act to continue the existing rates of income- tax for the financial year 1996- 97.

1.
Short title and commencement.
(1)
This Act may be called the Finance Act, 1996 .
(2)
It shall come into force on the 1st day of April, 1996 .

2.
Income- tax.
